sources.title: TI LP2985-33
sources.ref: Arduino Uno Rev3 schematic, arduino.cc, CC-BY-SA (A000066). Rev3e bill arduino_Uno_Rev3-02-TH. U2 is LP2985-33DBVR, the 3.3 V regulator. vOut 3.3 V is that fixed version

sources.title: Assumed electricals
sources.ref: Assumed from the legacy LP2985 (SNVS522), not read as a table cell here. Dropout 0.28 V at 0.15 A. Ground pin current 65 uA at no load. Short-circuit current 0.4 A. rOut is 0: no load-regulation row was used. The comparator reference draws about nothing, so the output is 3.3 V either way
